description: Changes a project's own details: only what you send. instructions replaces the project's instructions; sourcing_notes replaces its Sourcing notes card. view gallery opens the project with its renderings first and the items under them. claude_sourced true makes it a project Claude sources and manages: the gallery view then shows where the decision stands (step), the shopping cart per store with tax and the budget, the coded items, the install labels and the sourcing notes; it also sets the view to gallery unless view is sent. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

budget.description: The budget in dollars, all in (0 clears it)

claude_sourced.description: true: Claude sources and manages this project (the sourcing page); false: the ordinary gallery

instructions.description: The project's instructions, replacing the old ones

sourcing_notes.description: The Sourcing notes card, replacing what is there: markdown, ### headings, - bullets, [label](https://…) links. Send only the text; no date stamp

step.description: Where the decision stands: Design · Budget and stores · Items · Buy · Install

tax_rate.description: Sales tax in percent for the cart, e.g. 7

name: update_project
title: Change a project
